sourceHandlingInstructions: Constructive opening moves retain their original motion-directed content. Mixed cross-examination spans are evidence windows, not a claim that every word is spoken by the selected speaker. Attribute each concession and objection to its actual participant; only the selected move's claim and inference are scored. Exact quotations remain restricted to the correct speaker's quote-eligible words. Consult complete approved context for live replies, including those not selected as additional independent moves. Audio checks must finish before judgments; no caption or transcription artifact may become a participant error.
recoveryReview: The valid proposal was recovered by re-executing the exact read-only validation command captured in the same isolated worker's tool history.
